caption: 10tons' marble shooter origin - the cave paths that launched a finnish puzzle dynasty.
about: Sparkle (2007) is 10tons' first marble shooter: same rolling chains, darker cave aesthetics and a shooter rail that hugs the bottom of twisting paths. The prizmotep power system - collect prizmos, spend them on board effects - gave it an economy most marble games skipped, and the difficulty curve earned the studio its puzzle reputation.
The original pc build left the stores when 10tons rebuilt the concept as sparkle 2 and sparkle unleashed (both still sold); the 2007 original survives on archive routes.
